title: Analytical Procedures (Dissolution/RTRT)[Performance][Sakura Bloom 20 mg]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Dissolution/RTRT)[Performance][Sakura Bloom 20 mg].

action.title: Particle size
action.description: Laser diffraction particle size distribution analyzer

action.title: Granule particle size
action.description: The particle size of the granulation, the particle size at the end of granulation is obtained by a Focused Beam Reflectance Measurement (FBRM) method

action.title: Hardness
action.description: Tablet hardness tester. The uncoated tablet hardness is measured in 200 tablets (10 tablets  20 time points) sampled over time

action.title: Dissolution
action.description: Dissolution test was performed for the drug product manufactured under the conditions allocated by DoE, and the effect of each factor on the dissolution rate were investigated. The test results were subjected to multidimensional analysis

action.title: Dissolution rate
action.description: Calculated by the dissolution model at the time point of 30 minutes is 80% or higher

action.title: (continued)
action.description: Dissolution rate = A – B ´ particle size of drug substance – C ´ granule particle size – D ´ uncoated tablet hardness – E ´ particle size of drug substance ´ uncoated tablet hardness.
